{"consolidated_memory":"billing/webhooks/stripe.py: Duplicate charge incidents in webhook consumer (2 separate occasions)

SYMPTOM (both occasions):
- Duplicate charge in webhook consumer
- Repro: redeliver same webhook id twice
- Signal: two ledger rows sharing one event id
- Stack: Python
- Test file: tests/billing/test_stripe_webhook.py

FIRST INCIDENT [2026-08-08]:
- Context: occurred with traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: off-by-one in slice bound
- Fix: corrected slice bound and added property test
- PR #2004 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-1
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 9 percent to 863 requests per second

SECOND INCIDENT [2026-08-14]:
- Context: occurred on staging read replica
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #4463 on branch fix/duplicate-charge-2
- Measured outcome: backlog cleared 27 minutes after deploy

These were distinct problems with identical observable symptoms but requiring separate fixes."}
